description_en: Modifies the metric configuration of an existing ABTest experiment
description_zh: 用于修改已存在的AB测试实验指标配置
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice update-ab-metric --ab-metric-id 1 --name pv --description 'pv_指标' --scene-id 1 --type Single --realtime false --table-meta-id 2 --result-resource-id 3 --definition sum_click_cnt --statistics-cycle 1 --left-metric-id 2 --right-metric-id 3 --operator Division --instance-id pairec-cn-test123 --need-significance true --aggregation-by-user true --numerator click --denominator pv --is-binomial-distribution false --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateABMetric
